BLM.Title: Wild Canvas
BLM.Effect.Label: Animate as
BLM.Effect.Hint: Drawn over the scene image: the water or lava itself should already be on the map.
BLM.Setting.EnabledHint: Animate scene regions. This computer only — turn off on a weak machine.
BLM.Setting.StrengthHint: How visible glints, heat and fog are.
BLM.Setting.ambienceHint: Scene sound (forest, cave, tavern…) and area sounds: lava, water, swamp and campfire are heard over them and within two squares. Volume follows the Environment slider. This computer only.
BLM.Place.InsideHint: While a token is in the region this sound plays and the scene sound fades. Outline a building: tavern inside, forest outside.
BLM.Place.Label: Place sound
BLM.Place.Hint: Loops over the whole scene for everyone with Place sounds on.
BLM.Sound.Label: Sound
BLM.Volume.Label: Volume
BLM.Volume.Hint: Volume of this region's sound. The Environment slider sets the overall level.
BLM.Panel.Hint: All module settings are in this window. With BurnHub, the Wild Canvas tile opens it.
BLM.Effect.CutHint: Removes effects under this region; the water around keeps flowing. Outline a bridge or a deck.
BLM.Choice.fishKind.river: River and lake: trout, perch, carp, pike
BLM.Choice.fishKind.sea: Sea: mackerel, sea bream, cod, herring
BLM.Blaze.Label: Fire
BLM.Blaze.Hint: The tile itself burns: flames only where the image is opaque, swaying with a tree crown. Smoke drifts with the fire wind; light and crackle around.
BLM.Effect.FireHint: Outline a campfire: the flame sits in the middle, smoke drifts past the edge. Raise Wildfire to 1 to burn the whole region.
BLM.Setting.treeWindHint: How strongly tree crowns sway (tiles marked for wind, Kartograf sets them). 0 is calm.
BLM.Setting.treeWindDirectionHint: Where it blows, in degrees: 0 is right, 90 is down.
BLM.Setting.treeParticlesHint: How many particles tree crowns give off: leaves in autumn, fireflies in a magic forest (Kartograf sets the mark). 0 is off.
BLM.Setting.tokenSplash: Tokens in water, swamp and lava
BLM.Setting.tokenSplashHint: Splashes and ripples when a token steps into water and walks through it; bubbles in a swamp; the token burns in lava and fire.
BLM.Broken: Wild Canvas: the graphics card could not build the “{effect}” effect. Details in the console (F12).
BLM.Clouds.Title: Cloud shadows
BLM.Clouds.Hint: Cloud shadows drift with the Wild Canvas wind; now and then a cloud hides the sun. 0 is off. They fade at night.
BLM.Effect.WaterfallHint: Outline the falling water. Streams run along Direction (90 is down); foam and mist at the lower edge.
BLM.Effect.FountainHint: Outline the lower basin of a round fountain. A jet rises in the middle, water spills over the rims, rings spread from the middle to the edge.
BLM.Setting.groundWeatherHint: Under Foundry snow small drifts pile up and melt; under rain the floor gets wet: puddle reflections and drop rings. Not under roofs. This computer only.
BLM.Burrows.Title: Burrows
BLM.Burrows.Hint: A burrow stays where a token dug in (Burrow action) or came out.
FOOTSTEPS.SurfaceType.Label: Surface
FOOTSTEPS.SurfaceType.Hint: What a token's footsteps sound like in this region. Overrides Wild Canvas regions and the Cartographer surface grid.
BLM.Setting.footstepsHint: Token footstep sounds: marked regions, Wild Canvas water and swamp, and the floor of Cartographer maps. Volume follows the Environment slider. This computer only.
BLM.Speaker.Title: Speaker
BLM.Speaker.Label: Speaker with equalizer
BLM.Speaker.Hint: Bars dance to whatever music the player hears: Lazy Music, Foundry playlists and sounds. The GM toggles it from the tile HUD.
BLM.Machine.Title: Machinery
BLM.Machine.Label: Running machinery
BLM.Machine.Airship_Gnome_Brass_A: Gnome airship: spinning propellers, glowing runes
BLM.Hover.Title: Hover
BLM.Hover.Label: Floats in the air
BLM.Hover.Hint: Strength: 0 — still, 1 — the airship drifts, sways and casts a shadow on the ground.
BLM.Machine.Hint: For Cartographer cyberpunk set images: fan and light positions are taken from them.
BLM.Effect.RiftHint: A tear in reality right in the floor: the gap runs along the long side of the region, a starry void inside, cracks and time ripples around. Nothing needs to be painted on the map. The “Rift” macro places them faster.
BLM.Rift.Name: Rift
BLM.Rift.PlaceHint: Drag across the floor to lay a rift along it. Click for a rift in a random direction. Esc or right-click cancels.
BLM.Rift.StormOn: Anomaly storm: rifts will open by themselves.
BLM.Rift.NoArea: Anomaly storm: nowhere to open — select tokens or a region.
